# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 2173
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/2173
- **Title**: gh-2101 [GOAL] compaction: cache-aware summary/judge calls + pass metrics (duration/cost/cache-hit) in reports
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-2101` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 18
- **Additions**: +1552
- **Deletions**: -33
- **Created**: 2026-11-14T00:13:17Z
- **Updated**: 2026-11-14T02:39:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #2101
### What changed

Compaction's digest/judge LM calls are now cache-aware and its passes carry metrics. One compaction run shares ONE run-scoped cache routing id (`prompt_cache_key` / `x-session-id`) with a deliberate per-call-class `short` retention (`CompactionCachePolicy`) — replacing the blanket `cacheRetention: 'none'` + fresh-per-call ids — and pass reports gain duration (one-line) and cost + cache-hit (details view).

### Key decisions

- `CompactionCachePolicy.affine` (new, `lib/src/compaction/cache_policy.dart`): judge and digest adapters share one run-scoped id, so each pass's request prefix is served from the cache the previous pass wrote; the id is never the session's id, so the session's cache-affinity bucket stays untouched. Providers without cache knobs ignore the override (degrade to uncached); `CompactionCachePolicy.isolated()` keeps the legacy opt-out.
- Usage flows through a run-scoped `CompactionUsageAccumulator` (adapters get an optional `onUsage` callback); engines fold per-pass deltas into `StructuredCompactionPass`/`AutoCompactorPass`. Absent usage renders nothing — never a fake zero; cache 0% stays visible as the regression signal.
- Hides stay batched: one `hidden_range` append per pass — now pinned by a regression test (multi-group judge pick → exactly one append).
- `AutoCompactorFactory` is non-const now: it memoizes the per-run policy + ledger (a factory instance = one run's identity).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/compaction/cache_policy_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_pass_metrics_test.dart \
  test/compaction/summary_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_ledger_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_engine_test.dart \
  test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart \
  test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart
```

Payload-level prefix reuse is pinned by wire fixtures (`summary_test.dart` → `prompt_cache_key` identical across a run's calls, absent under the isolated policy).

<details><summary>Metrics flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[provider Usage] -->|onUsage| L[CompactionUsageAccumulator]
  L -->|per-pass delta| P[pass receipts]
  P -->|durationMs| O[one-line report · 12.4s]
  P -->|cost + cache-hit| D[details: llm 2 calls · $0.0412 · cache 87%]
```

</details>

# pr-2173: gh-2101 [GOAL] compaction: cache-aware summary/judge calls + pass metrics (duration/cost/cache-hit) in reports

## Description

Closes #2101
### What changed

Compaction's digest/judge LM calls are now cache-aware and its passes carry metrics. One compaction run shares ONE run-scoped cache routing id (`prompt_cache_key` / `x-session-id`) with a deliberate per-call-class `short` retention (`CompactionCachePolicy`) — replacing the blanket `cacheRetention: 'none'` + fresh-per-call ids — and pass reports gain duration (one-line) and cost + cache-hit (details view).

### Key decisions

- `CompactionCachePolicy.affine` (new, `lib/src/compaction/cache_policy.dart`): judge and digest adapters share one run-scoped id, so each pass's request prefix is served from the cache the previous pass wrote; the id is never the session's id, so the session's cache-affinity bucket stays untouched. Providers without cache knobs ignore the override (degrade to uncached); `CompactionCachePolicy.isolated()` keeps the legacy opt-out.
- Usage flows through a run-scoped `CompactionUsageAccumulator` (adapters get an optional `onUsage` callback); engines fold per-pass deltas into `StructuredCompactionPass`/`AutoCompactorPass`. Absent usage renders nothing — never a fake zero; cache 0% stays visible as the regression signal.
- Hides stay batched: one `hidden_range` append per pass — now pinned by a regression test (multi-group judge pick → exactly one append).
- `AutoCompactorFactory` is non-const now: it memoizes the per-run policy + ledger (a factory instance = one run's identity).

### How to verify

```bash
dart test test/compaction/cache_policy_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_pass_metrics_test.dart \
  test/compaction/summary_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_ledger_test.dart \
  test/compaction/structured_engine_test.dart \
  test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart \
  test/agent/auto_compactor_test.dart
```

Payload-level prefix reuse is pinned by wire fixtures (`summary_test.dart` → `prompt_cache_key` identical across a run's calls, absent under the isolated policy).

<details><summary>Metrics flow</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[provider Usage] -->|onUsage| L[CompactionUsageAccumulator]
  L -->|per-pass delta| P[pass receipts]
  P -->|durationMs| O[one-line report · 12.4s]
  P -->|cost + cache-hit| D[details: llm 2 calls · $0.0412 · cache 87%]
```

</details>

💡 **SUGGESTION: `formatPassDuration` renders `1m60s` in the ~500 ms window before each minute boundary**

The minutes branch rounds the remainder, so a remainder of `≥ 59.5` rounds to `60` and the rendered minute is never carried:

```dart
final rest = (seconds - minutes * 60).round(); // 119.7s → round(59.7) = 60
return '${minutes}m${rest.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}s';
```

Verified against the shipped implementation:

| ms in | out |
|---|---|
| 119400 | `1m59s` |
| 119700 | **`1m60s`** (should be `2m00s`) |
| 239600 | **`3m60s`** |

That lands in the one-line compaction report (`… · 1m60s`) for any pass duration in `[119.5s, 120s)` and at every later minute boundary — violating the documented `XmSSs` shape (`2m05s`). Floor the remainder instead:

```dart
final rest = (seconds - minutes * 60).floor();
```

The same `.round()`-at-boundary concern does not apply to the hours branch (`rest` is computed from integral minutes there). Add a `119700`-style case to `cache_policy_test.dart`'s `formatPassDuration` group to pin it.

arguments.content:
💡 **SUGGESTION: a failed judge call's metered usage and wall-clock never reach any pass receipt**

This run's measurement window opens here (usage snapshot + watch before `_callJudge`), but on the judge-failure path the window's results are dropped: `_registerJudgeFailure` (`engine.dart:741`) and `_latchedSkipHide` (`engine.dart:791`) emit their `ok: false` receipts without `durationMs`/`usage`, and the retry loop opens a fresh snapshot on the next pass, so the failed call's spend falls between snapshots.

Concretely: the judge adapter deliberately folds usage "for every answered call — the metrics fold what was actually spent, even when the answer itself is unusable" (`judge.dart:167-169`), so a judge call that burns $0.02 and 900k cached input tokens on an unusable answer increments the run ledger — yet renders **no** `llm:` line on the failed pass, and the succeeding retry's line carries only the retry's delta. Under-reported cost exactly on the path these metrics exist to diagnose (expensive, failing judges). The classic engine does not have this gap: `_runPass` snapshots once per pass and folds **all** attempts' usage into the receipt, failures included (`auto_compactor.dart:476-477,589`).

Also note the ledger test's reason string ("a failed judge call reports no usage") only holds because the fake reports `Usage.zero` — a real aborted-but-metered call does report. Suggested fix: carry the already-open `watch`/`usageBefore` into the `_registerJudgeFailure` receipt (`durationMs: watch.elapsedMilliseconds, usage: _usageDelta(usageBefore)`), keeping the "absent, never fake zero" contract for the skip path. The receipt lines are unchanged code, hence this lives in the general comment too — the anchor here is the new window-opening lines that orphan the measurement.

## Automated Code Review — APPROVE (with suggestions)

**Summary**: gh-2101 lands as designed — the run-scoped `CompactionCachePolicy` never touches the session's cache bucket (verified against the adapter's `_applyPromptCacheParams`), usage folding renders absent rather than fake-zero, hides stay batched per pass, and legacy reports stay byte-identical; all 7 named test files pass (115 tests) and `dart analyze` is clean. Three 💡 suggestions below, none blocking.

**Key Issues**:
- `lib/src/compaction/cache_policy.dart:221` — `formatPassDuration` rounds the minute remainder and renders `1m60s`/`3m60s` for durations in the ~500 ms window before a minute boundary (verified: 119700 ms → `1m60s`); floor it instead.
- `lib/src/compaction/cache_policy.dart:97` — `isolated()` doc claims "a config-level opt-out" but no config knob selects it anywhere; drop the phrase or wire the key.
- `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:570` — a failed judge call's metered usage/wall-clock opens this measurement window but reaches no pass receipt (`_registerJudgeFailure` at engine.dart:741 emits `ok:false` without `durationMs`/`usage`), so failing-judge spend is under-reported vs the classic engine, which folds failed attempts in.
- Digest (no threads): the zero-usage predicate is triplicated (`judge.dart:182`, `compaction.dart:884`, `cache_policy.dart:186`) — one shared `Usage` helper would do; `_passUsage` (`auto_compactor.dart:589`) and `_usageDelta` (`engine.dart:1370`) are the same snapshot-delta helper twice; `summary_test.dart:870` captures request `headers` but never asserts them.

**Next Steps**:
1. Floor the duration remainder and pin it with a `119700 → 2m00s` test case.
